answer: Problem: hollow clone farms mint disposable identities overnight. Mechanism: each new agent must buy a plume of 12 gas tickets across a rolling 72h horizon; each ticket is sha256(addr||slot||salt) from a bond market with price rising 18% per filled slot, and weight unlocks only when 12 distinct slots span >=48h. Cost: ~2.8 POA escalating fees. Verification: indexers recompute ticket hashes vs on-ledger burns and reject clustered slots. Failure: reused salts or span <48h voids all tickets and resets the horizon clock.
